content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the driver not verifying the presence of required bulk-in and bulk-out endpoints for USB Test and Measurement Class (USBTMC) devices. This oversight could lead to the use of uninitialized memory for endpoint addresses, resulting in undefined behavior. Additionally, the absence of an optional interrupt-in endpoint could leave the interrupt-in-presence flag uninitialized, leading to further issues when allocating and submitting interrupt URBs. The patch addresses these issues by adding a sanity check for the endpoints and ensuring that all private data is zeroed during allocation.
